title: Global section lifting for a proper map and a quasi-compact open of an affine base
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $T$ an affine scheme, $p:V\to T$ proper, $O\subseteq T$ a quasi-compact open with inclusion $j$, and $M$ a sheaf of constant-$A$ modules on $V\times_T O$. Write $k:V\times_TO\to V$ for the projection and $F=p_*k_!M$, using the intrinsic constant-module operations. Then the component on global sections of the specified open-adjunction counit $\epsilon_F:j_!j^*F\to F$ is surjective: $\Gamma(T,j_!j^*F)\to\Gamma(T,F)$ is surjective. Here global sections are evaluation at $\operatorname{id}_T$ in $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$.

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AG; the affine support argument recorded in Steps 3--11 of lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison

proof.text: Write the quasi-compact open O of affine T as a finite union of principal opens D(f_j). For I=(f_j), use the affine closed-specialization localization T_Z at elements invertible modulo I. The principal opens and T_Z form a pro-etale cover; every point of T_Z specializes to Z=V(I). The empty union is permitted.

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AG; the affine support argument recorded in Steps 3--11 of lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison

proof.text: Proper closedness forces every point of V times_T T_Z to specialize into the inverse image of Z: apply closedness to the closure of that point. Cover the proper inverse image by finitely many affine charts, and closed-localize these charts at the inverse image of Z. These affine localizations cover, since every specialization lies in a chart containing its generalizations. Their finite family is a pro-etale cover; separatedness controls affine intersections. The specialization-zero theorem gives zero sections of the extension by zero on each chart, hence zero on the whole inverse image.

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AG; the affine support argument recorded in Steps 3--11 of lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison

proof.text: On each principal open the counit is invertible by the open-unit triangle identity. On T_Z both its source and the target section vanish by specialization-zero and the preceding step. Lift by the inverse on the principal opens and by zero on T_Z. The open counit is monic, since presheaf zero extension is monic and module sheafification is exact; therefore the lifts agree on overlaps. Glue them. The constant-module realization equivalences preserve the counit and the sections, giving the specified intrinsic global-sections map.

theorem sfProperQcOpenCounit_sections_surjective {V T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T]
    (p : V ⟶ T) [IsProper p] (O : T.Opens) (hO : IsCompact (O : Set T))
    (M : proEtaleRingModules (pullback p O.ι)
      (proEtaleConstantRing (pullback p O.ι) A)) :
    let F := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero (pullback.fst p O.ι) A ⋙
      proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage p A).obj M
    Function.Surjective
      (((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZeroAdjunction O.ι A).counit.app F).val.app
        (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 T))))
